rules.statement: A purchaser at a public auction of immovable property is entitled to sue a notary for the refund of exorbitant fees paid under a mistake of fact to the notary for attesting the conditions of sale.
rules.supporting_quote: "This appeal involves a question of some importance relating to the rights and obligations of a purchaser at a public auction of immovable property in regard to the notarial fees payable by him for having the conditions of sale attested."
